summary: Iteration 5 security remediation VERIFIED. Backend: 89/89 pytest pass (serial, -o addopts=''), including 20 new test_security.py tests. SEC-001: old hard-coded passwords (Citizen!2026/Responder!2026/Operator!2026/Admin!2026) all rejected 401; new env-sourced passwords work for all 4 roles; auth screen has zero autofill chips/passwords in DOM, and grep of the served 8.3MB JS bundle found 0 credential strings. SEC-002: demo/reset 401 unauth, 403 citizen/responder/operator, 200 admin (data-verified wipe). SEC-003: anonymous + bad-token WS refused (handshake rejected), authenticated ping/pong ok, citizen socket receives incident.created but NOT responder.location (operator receives both). SEC-004: raw ?token=JWT on /api/files now 401; /api/media/sign returns 10-min HMAC URL that fetches 200 with NO auth header; tampered + expired signatures 401; citizen signing foreign media 403, unknown path 404, unauth sign 401; Authorization-header path still 200. Rate limit: 10 failed logins per unique email all 401, 11th 429. Frontend regression (390x844) with NEW creds typed manually: citizen login -> SOS w/ gallery photo -> LLM triage (openai/gpt-5.6-terra, ~2s) -> StatusCard + media-thumb loaded via signed URL (mt/exp params, no token=) -> pill LIVE; operator Command Center (analytics panel + KPIs, Leaflet 8 tiles, incident card, media thumb + provider label in review panel, APPROVE DISPATCH ok, alert published); responder full lifecycle ACCEPTED->EN_ROUTE->ON_SCENE->COMPLETED + alerts-strip realtime receipt + media thumb; citizen then saw RESOLVED incident, alert strip, old-password inline 401 error, offline outbox (pill RECONNECTING in ~1s, '1 SOS is queued offline' banner, auto-flush ~2s after reconnect, pill back to LIVE).

issues: In-modal buttons (sos-people-increase, confirm-sos-button) render below the fold; modal scrolls fine for real users but Playwright needs JS scrollIntoView. Carried over from iter 3/4 — optional spacing tightening only.

action_items: NONE blocking. Security fixes all independently confirmed.
OPTIONAL: pytest class-scoped fixture in test_security.py (media_path) emits PytestRemovedIn10Warning — works today; convert to @classmethod if pytest 10 upgrade is planned.
OPTIONAL: FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown deprecated (lifespan handlers) — cosmetic warnings only, carried over from iter 4.

NOTE (by design, not a bug): WS JWT travels in ?token= query param because browser/RN WebSocket clients cannot set headers — it appears in browser console network errors; SEC-004 scope (raw JWT in FILE urls) is fully closed. If desired later, move WS auth to a short-lived one-time ticket.
critical_code_review_comments: SEC-001: seed_users() reads DEMO_<ROLE>_PASSWORD from env and rotates hashes on every startup; nothing credential-like in frontend source (grep clean) or served bundle (8.3MB grep clean); auth-screen.tsx only references memory/test_credentials.md docs.
SEC-002: demo/reset now Depends(require_roles('ADMIN')) + DEMO_MODE gate; verified 401/403x3/200 + actual wipe.

SEC-003: WS token verified pre-accept (jwt.decode + user re-read, disabled rejected), ConnectionManager tracks role per socket, PRIVILEGED_EVENTS={'responder.location'} skipped for CITIZEN sockets — verified live with dual citizen+operator sockets.

SEC-004: get_file branches on mt/exp (HMAC-SHA256 over path:exp, 40-char truncated, hmac.compare_digest, expiry checked) else Bearer; media/sign re-uses assert_media_access (owner OR media on own incident for citizens) — full matrix verified.

Rate limiter: in-memory sliding window, 10/300s keyed by email only on login+signup, checked BEFORE credential verification (fail-closed, also throttles user enumeration). 11th attempt 429 verified. Note: in-memory means multi-worker deployments would bypass — fine for single-process preview.
CORS allow_credentials=False with allow_origins=['*'] confirmed at server.py:906.
seed_data_creation: TEST signup users persist in db.users (TEST-signup-*, TEST-scope-* from prior iters — harmless CITIZENs). All TEST incidents/alerts wiped via final admin POST /api/demo/reset; test alert deactivated before reset. Rate-limit test used unique nonexistent email (TEST-ratelimit-*) so no real account was locked out.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 audit findings + rate limiting verified fixed; full E2E regression green with new creds. Test infra: conftest.py now uses Cs!* passwords from memory/test_credentials.md, admin_token fixture for demo/reset, ws_url(token) helper for WS tests; test_security.py must run LAST alphabetically (admin reset wipes data, rate-limit test burns attempts). WS ?token= is required — anonymous connects get handshake-rejected (HTTP 403 surfaced by websockets lib as InvalidStatus; close code 4401 in the ASGI message). Frontend: in-modal clicks need JS scrollIntoView+click; each browser_automation call is a fresh profile; wait for 'Uploading photo' to clear before confirm-sos-button. responder-map only renders when incident has GPS coordinates (headless browser has no geolocation → placeholder shown, expected).
rca_of_issue: No app bugs found this iteration. Test-side migrations only: (1) conftest CREDENTIALS updated to env-sourced Cs!* passwords, reset_demo fixture now logs in as admin first (SEC-002 broke the old public-reset fixture); (2) test_realtime_ai WS connections updated to ws_url(token) after SEC-003 made auth mandatory; (3) test_media_alerts TestFileDownload rewritten from raw ?token= flow to signed-URL flow after SEC-004.
